data.name: Wake Early : Save Big! Early Bird Tour
data.headline: 2 Hours • Save Big! • Must be 21+ to rent • SAVE UP TO $50. The EARLY BIRD 1/2 DAY SPECIAL
data.description:
**SAVE UP TO $50. The EARLY BIRD SPECIAL is two hours for the price of one.**
 
Let GoCar take you off the beaten path through many of San Diego’s iconic parks like the Balboa Park and Petco Park on the way to Hillcrest and back. Snap some amazing photos along the Pacific Ocean and see the San Diego up close. You can even park and take a stroll along if you choose. On the way back explore the boutique shopping districts of Hillcrest. This tour is approximately two hours drive time at a slow pace and has several fun, informative detours and stop options along the way. If you want to extend the tour you have the option of taking the Oldtown loop at the end of the tour.

data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations are not permitted unless Trip Protection is purchased at the time of booking.

With Trip Protection, you may cancel up to 2 hours before your scheduled tour for a full refund.

No-shows or late arrivals without Trip Protection will be charged the full booking amount.

GoCar Tours reserves the right to reschedule or refund tours in the event of severe weather, safety concerns, or unforeseen circumstances.
data.booking_notes:
##Please arrive at least 15 min before your scheduled departure time. 

-Departure times are approximated due to customers prior to your reservation possibly taking longer than they were booked for.

- If you wish to keep your car longer than what you have booked for, you are welcome, but please check that it is available for you to keep and not needed by another renter. 

- Additional time is charged in 15 minute increments at our standard internet rates. 

- Please make sure you return the car before we close. Late returns are billed at $1 per minute. Please check with staff on day of rental the close time of the location. Early returns will not be refunded for unused time.

###Slingshot waivers will be sent by Polaris Outfitters.  Look out for an email.
data.restrictions:
- GoCars hold a maximum of 2 people. Prices are per GoCar, not per person.
- Must be 21 years or older to rent. Must possess a major credit card and valid driver’s license (international license is not necessary). GoCars do not accommodate car seats for children.
- On the day of rental, a security deposit will be held on your credit card until the GoCar is returned. All riders must sign a standard participant agreement. Renters will have the option to purchase Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) insurance on the day of rental.
- Renters are free to extend the length of their tour on the day of rental. Additional rental time will be charged in 15-minute increments.
data.disclaimers: Your tour’s length may vary due to circumstances such as departure time and location, traffic and your itinerary. If you do take additional rental time, this will be billed in 15-minute increments at our retail rates. You may visit all or some the tour’s highlights. If you are unsure of which tour to book, just book according to the amount of time you think you’d like to spend. We can customize a tour especially for you, with the sights you want to include, when you come into our shop.
